capabilities: make HTTP/HTTPS requests from markdown code blocks
extract values from responses with JSONPath
chain requests using data from previous responses
disambiguation: Not a browser or web-viewer; it only fetches API responses and renders them inside note code blocks.
extras: Full documentation is hosted externally, not in the README; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to call HTTP endpoints from inside a note and render the response data.
summary: Code-block-based tool that makes web requests from notes, extracts values with JSONPath, renders results via Handlebars, and chains requests.
